title: How to get through the 3 p.m. slump at work
dek: The early afternoon dip comes from your body clock, not just lunch. A walk, daylight, water and the right tasks help more than a late coffee.
keywords: how to stay focused in the afternoon
keyPoints: The early afternoon dip is part of your natural daily rhythm and can happen even if you skip lunch.
Henry Ford Health suggests keeping caffeine to the morning, getting daylight and drinking water.
If you can nap, Henry Ford Health suggests 15 to 20 minutes; BBC Science Focus warns that naps over 30 minutes can leave you groggy.
Plan low-effort tasks for roughly 2 to 3 p.m. and save deep work for other hours.

sources.title: Feeling Drowsy? How To Overcome The Midday Slump | Henry Ford Health - Detroit, MI
How to beat the afternoon slump (without a nap) | BBC Science Focus Magazine

body: If your focus fades in mid-afternoon, your body clock is a big part of the reason. Henry Ford Health explains that the signals keeping us alert naturally dip in the early afternoon, and the sleep drive builds the longer we are awake. BBC Science Focus notes the dip can show up even if you skip lunch, although a heavy meal may make it feel deeper.

Reaching for a second coffee is the common fix, but Henry Ford Health suggests keeping caffeine to the morning so it does not cut into tonight's sleep. Its other suggestions are simple. Get some sunlight or bright light, take a short walk outdoors, drink water since even mild dehydration can add to fatigue, and pair a snack with some protein instead of reaching for sugar alone.

If your job allows a nap, keep it short. Henry Ford Health suggests 15 to 20 minutes, and BBC Science Focus warns that naps over 30 minutes can leave you groggy. If napping is not an option, a walk is a good substitute.

It also helps to plan around the dip. Schedule easier tasks for roughly 2 to 3 p.m., such as answering routine messages or planning tomorrow, and keep demanding work for the morning or late afternoon. Frequent sleepiness that gets in the way of your day is worth raising with a doctor, since it can point to a sleep problem.
Right now, stand up, get a glass of water and step outside or near a window for five minutes before your next easy task.
